_note: PRICING-1 · THE PRICE LIST. Every price, band edge, setup fee and band-move rule is in this one file. The server reads it at boot (pricing.js) and serves it at GET /public/pricing, which is what signup, Billing and the plan picker read, so a change here takes a server redeploy and no code change and no client build. The marketing site prerenders its one line ('Everything included, from $199/mo.') from this file at build and corrects it from /public/pricing on load. Price is set by RECORDS: people and organizations with at least one gift. Prospects, volunteers and contacts with no gift never count. Every band has three Stripe prices (monthly, yearly, one-time setup), each named by the env var that carries its id. `legacyTiers` are the GTM-1a bands that real organisations may be on: recognised for ever, never offered.
